metodos.codigoOriginal:
Lparameters poForm, pOperacao

ThisForm.ParentForm = poForm
ThisForm.DataSessionId = poForm.DataSessionId
ThisForm.poDatamgr = poForm.poDataMgr
ThisForm.GetOrigem.Value = pOperacao
ThisForm.GetOrigem.Refresh

ThisForm.cntSombra.lblSombra.Caption = ThisForm.Caption
ThisForm.cntSombra.lblTitulo.Caption = ThisForm.Caption

LOCAL xBrox

If !IsEmpty( This.Value )
	xBrox = CreateObject('fwBuscaExt',Thisform.poDatamgr.pnIdconn,'SigCdOpe','csSigCdOpe','Dopes',This.Value,'Operações',.t.,'Dopes')

	If  Not xBrox.plAchouRegistro
		xBrox.mAddColuna('Dopes', '', 'Operação', .t.)
		xBrox.Show()
	EndIf 
	This.Value = Iif( LastKey() # 27, Evaluate('csSigCdOpe.Dopes'), '' )
Else
	If Lastkey() <> 27
		MessageBox("Operação Deve ser informada !!!",16,"")
		Return .f.
	Endif
Endif

If NOt Empty(This.Value) And Not Lastkey() = 27
	ThisForm.poDatamgr.Sqlexecute([Select dopes from SigCdOpe Where Dopes = ']+this.Value+['],'csSigCdOpe')
	Select csSigCdOpe
	If ! Eof()
		MessageBox('Operação já Cadastrada !!!',16,'')
		Return .f.
	EndIf
EndIf

If Empty(ThisForm.GetOrigem.Value)
	MessageBox('Origem Invalida !!!',16,'')
	Return
EndIf

If Empty(ThisForm.GetDestino.Value)
	MessageBox('Destino Invalido !!!',16,'')
	Return
EndIf

lcOpeOri = ThisForm.GetOrigem.Value
lcOpeDes = ThisForm.GetDestino.Value

lnNDopes = fGerUniqueKey("SigCdOpe")	
lcProgramas = Padl(lnNDopes, 8, '0')

Zap In crSigCdOpe
Zap In crSigOpCdc
Zap In crSigOpCdi
Zap In crSigOpCsn
Zap In crSigOpCrr
Zap In crSigOpDup
Zap In crSigCdPrg
Zap In crSigOpCdd
Zap In crSigMvCxs
Zap ... [TRUNCADO]
